title: Great day trip to Tangier
text: We had a wonderful day and experience!  The drive from Seville was long but we were so grateful to have a personal driver to take us both ways. All was very organized and smooth! Ali spent the whole day with us in Tangier and he was terrific and enthusiastic showing us everything and everyone we encountered along the way were wonderful!
author: Erin_K

title: We had a great time in...
text:
We had a great time in Tangier. 
Everything that was mentioned in the description of this tour was fulfilled. As soon as it was booked, I was contacted on WhatsApp with clear instructions and our ferry tickets from the tour operator/Ali and on top of that, we were also called and asked if there was anything specific we would like to see or explore whilst in Tangier. There are no hidden costs and it is truly an all inclusive VIP experience.
Our guide Mr Coca Cola was very knowledgeable and helpful which made our day more enjoyable. As he said it himself  “ Coca Cola treats you like a baby from
author: M_G

title: Fabulous whirlwind tour...
text:
Fabulous whirlwind tour of Tangiers in a day with Ali. He was passionate and knowledgeable about showing us the sites and discussing their culture. We had a fabulous day. 
Near the end of the tour our neurodivergent daughter began to feel overwhelm and Ali was supportive and understanding in helping us reduce her triggers.
author: Sue_P

title: A great day in Tangier
text: We had such a great day. Kareem was a fantastic guide and brought the city to life. We are planning to come back based on our tour.
author: andrea_c

title: The Ultimate Shore Excursion
text:

title: A wonderful taste of Morocco
text: We very much enjoyed our trip to Tangier.  Omar was a great guide, full of enthusiasm.  We saw beautiful sites and ate delicious food.  Our favorite part was walking through the narrow streets of the medina.
author: Joan_B

title: Tangier-The BEST tour ever
text: What a fantastic, memorable tour! Ali was an incredible guide and the entire tour from pickup, to ferry, to meeting in Tangier and then the trip back to Seville were top notch. Ali was so kind and so knowledgeable. Our tour was a history class as much as it was a tour. We loved every site we visited. I would highly recommend this tour and if you can, please ask for Ali. Our exploration of the city was the most fun. We felt like we saw the areas not on every other tour. The small back streets and shops were incredible. title: Fantastic Guide
text: Ali was fantastic. From communication soon after we booked to the places we ate, all the history he showed and told us about, it was all top notch and worth the money.
author: Dave_N

title: Best tour guide ever - Ali ~
text: Ali is the best tour guide ever.  He stays in constant communication. He met us at the port and saw us off at the port.  We stay in touch with him.  He's a wonderful person and you will have an amazing time with his tour.
author: tammyjewel628

title: Great Tour and guide
text: Ali was a wonderful guide, our trip was fall of 2022, but didn't give me that date to choose.  He has very good English, gave us good insight into his home country, and even some surprises.  We had a wonderful experience and would book with Ali again
